title: The offset pair of through-bores
question: The upper-left image is an isometric view of a 3D model, and the right image is the Front View. Which of the lower images is the model's Top View? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D. The plate has two vertical through-bores and no other cuts or bosses.

options.label: D
options.text: All three other options are incorrect
